framework.p4_desc: Software is alive. We provide active maintenance, performance monitoring, and iterate on new features based on real analytics.

workflows.hero_subtitle: Your team loses up to 40% of their time moving data between tools, seeking approvals, and putting out operational fires. We design workflow engines that eliminate friction, connect your systems, and automate corporate bureaucracy 100%.
workflows.compare_subtitle: Why keep operating in the past?
workflows.compare_desc: Your team is trained to think, not to copy and paste data between 5 different tools.
workflows.capabilities_desc: We design the business logic and automate repetitive tasks across all your departments.
workflows.integration_desc: We eliminate information silos by connecting your current ecosystem (SAP, Salesforce, HubSpot, NetSuite) into a centralized and bidirectional data flow.
workflows.use_cases_desc: This is how our clients are already multiplying their productivity with orchestrated flows.
workflows.uc1_desc: Automatic account creation across platforms, credential delivery, and contract generation.
workflows.uc2_desc: OCR extraction from PDFs, data matching with ERP, and payment scheduling without manual intervention.
workflows.uc3_desc: Intelligent incident routing based on urgency and client, with direct alerts to Slack or Teams.
workflows.process_desc: We implement complex systems in record time without interrupting your current operations.
workflows.cta_desc: Let the systems work for you. Schedule a free audit with our engineering team.

desarrollo.hero_subtitle: We build SaaS platforms, enterprise applications, and mission-critical web ecosystems. Clean architecture, native scalability, and extreme performance from the first commit.
desarrollo.features_desc: We are not a "web agency". We build robust digital assets designed to withstand millions of requests and stand the test of time.
desarrollo.feature1_desc: Your software shouldn't break when you succeed. We design cloud architectures (Microservices, Serverless) capable of horizontally scaling automatically. From 100 to 100,000 users without losing a millisecond.
desarrollo.feature2_desc: We don't leave security for the end. We implement bank-grade encryption, multi-factor authentication, and protection protocols against injections and DDoS attacks from day one of development.
desarrollo.expertise_desc: From native mobile applications to complex backend systems, we master the technologies that power modern businesses.
desarrollo.exp1_desc: We develop multi-tenant software with integrated billing, dashboards, and large-scale user management.
desarrollo.exp2_desc: Seamless experiences on iOS and Android using React Native to maximize reach and reduce development times.
desarrollo.exp3_desc: Decoupled and high-performance backend architectures that allow your systems to communicate securely.
desarrollo.exp4_desc: We migrate legacy systems to modern cloud infrastructures, improving security and reducing costs.
desarrollo.cta_desc: Let's talk about architecture, databases, and viability. We will give you an honest technical evaluation of your project.

ecosistema.hero_subtitle: We connect your ERP, CRM, billing software, and custom apps into a unified Command Center. We break down information silos so your company operates with a single source of truth.
ecosistema.dashboard_desc: Visualize and control your company's pulse instantly. We integrate BI dashboards, sales analytics, and operational status in real time.
ecosistema.sync_desc: We build native integrations and robust APIs. What happens in Salesforce is reflected in SAP in milliseconds, without human intervention.
ecosistema.cta_desc: Unify your systems today. Let our data engineers analyze your architecture at no cost.
ecosistema.showcase_desc: We design and develop interfaces that not only look incredible but are built to handle massive data flows and complex operations without friction.
ecosistema.bento_desc: We build every piece of your digital infrastructure to operate in perfect sync.
ecosistema.c1_desc: Resource, inventory, and billing management adapted 100% to your business processes, without the limitations of canned software.
ecosistema.c2_desc: Customer tracking, sales pipeline, and marketing automation powered by data analytics.
ecosistema.c3_desc: Self-service spaces for your corporate clients. Bulk orders, shipment tracking, and invoice management.
ecosistema.c4_desc: Centralization of all operational information for real-time analytics (PowerBI/Tableau).

ia.hero_subtitle: We supercharge your workflows and custom software with Artificial Intelligence. From cognitive automation in n8n to AI-driven code generation and architectures.
ia.services_desc: We connect Artificial Intelligence directly to the core of your operations and the software we build for you.
ia.s1_desc: We inject smart decision-making into your n8n flows. Automatic classification, semantic routing, and data extraction from documents without human intervention.
ia.s2_desc: We accelerate software creation using advanced code generation. We build scalable architectures faster and with higher precision thanks to AI.
ia.s3_desc: We develop autonomous agents that connect to your APIs, databases, and CRMs to execute complex multi-step tasks on your behalf.
ia.s4_desc: We connect language models (GPT/Claude) with your company's private knowledge so you can interact with your database using natural language.
ia.architecture_title: Artificial Intelligence isn't magic, it's Engineering.
ia.architecture_desc: This is how we orchestrate AI agents within scalable workflows, connecting triggers, databases, and communication systems in real time.
ia.arch_b1_desc: AI analyzes and routes data instantly, eliminating human bottlenecks.
ia.arch_b2_desc: Multiply your operational capacity by 10x without needing to increase your headcount.
ia.arch_b3_desc: Your data never leaves your protected environment. Absolute control over the models.
ia.process_desc: We embed AI where it adds the most value, whether in a daily workflow or in the source code of your app.
ia.cta_desc: Discover how AI can multiply the efficiency of your workflows and developments.
